metadata.question: Did the nighttime brightness at Biju Patnaik Airport decrease more than the brightness at Saheed Nagar (20.290813, 85.848691) between April 30, 2019 and May 5, 2019?

data.raw_code: The question is about comparing nighttime brightness changes at two locations (Biju Patnaik Airport and Saheed Nagar) between April 30, 2019 and May 5, 2019. 1. Data Collection: I need to use VIIRS nighttime lights data (VNP46A2 or VNP46A1) which provides daily nighttime brightness data. 2. Locations: - Biju Patnaik Airport: I'll need to look up coordinates or use a point near Bhubaneswar, Odisha - Saheed Nagar: Given coordinates (20.290813, 85.848691) 3. Time period: April 30, 2019 to May 5, 2019 (6 days) 4. Approach: - Get nighttime brightness for both locations at start (April 30) and end (May 5) - Calculate the change (end - start) for each location - Compare which location had a larger decrease (more negative change) 5. Data validation: - Check if images exist for both dates at both locations - Check if valid pixels exist after masking - Validate the brightness values are reasonable For VIIRS data, I'll use the 'DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m' band or similar. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define locations const airport = ee.Geometry.Point([85.8170, 20.2543]); // Biju Patnaik Airport coordinates const saheedNagar = ee.Geometry.Point([85.848691, 20.290813]); // Given coordinates // Define date range const startDate = '2019-04-30'; const endDate = '2019-05-05'; // Get VIIRS nighttime lights collection const viirs = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); // Check collection size const count = viirs.size().getInfo(); console.log(`VIIRS images found: ${count}`); if (count === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get images for start and end dates const startImg = viirs.filterDate('2019-04-30', '2019-05-01').first(); const endImg = viirs.filterDate('2019-05-04', '2019-05-06').first(); if (!startImg || !endImg) { console.log("Missing start or end date images"); console.log("C1"); return; } // Extract brightness values using avg_rad band const airportStart = startImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: airport, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const airportEnd = endImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: airport, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const saheedStart = startImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: saheedNagar, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); const saheedEnd = endImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: saheedNagar, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); console.log(`Airport: ${airportStart?.toFixed(3)} -> ${airportEnd?.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`Saheed: ${saheedStart?.toFixed(3)} -> ${saheedEnd?.toFixed(3)}`); // Check for null values if (airportStart === null || airportEnd === null || saheedStart === null || saheedEnd === null) { console.log("Null values detected"); console.log("C3"); return; } // Calculate changes (decrease = negative change) const airportChange = airportEnd - airportStart; const saheedChange = saheedEnd - saheedStart; console.log(`Airport change: ${airportChange.toFixed(3)}`); console.log(`Saheed change: ${saheedChange.toFixed(3)}`); // Check if airport decreased more than saheed (more negative) if (airportChange < saheedChange) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
